messages:
Priya: Quick sync 1: need to lock prioritization for Optimize toolkit next sprint: batching heuristics, prefix caching, quantization recommendations, eval-triggered alerts. Who can surface acceptance criteria, customer risks, rollout constraints?

Emma: I'll own batching + caching acceptance. Need target p99 SLO and cost-savings bands (15%, 25%, 40%).

Jason: Ops: we need pilot enrollment flow, feature flags, telemetry schema. Propose alpha/beta tiers to gate customers.

Oliver: SRE risks: KV eviction patterns, hot-shard amplification, memory pressure with large batch windows. Recommend canary rollout with rate caps.

Miguel: Customers want a simple UX: "cost vs latency" slider and safe default quant profiles. AcmeHealth interested in pilot.

Priya: Draft acceptance criteria: batching -> >=15% cost reduction on pilot without p99 > SLO; cache -> correct hits for 99% of cached prefixes + TTL/invalidation controls; quant recs -> <=3% degradation on key metric or manual opt-out; eval alerts -> threshold config, sample set, slack/email delivery. Objections?

Emma: Add perf artifacts: benchmark table, representative workloads, example config snippet. Sample config:
```
optimize:
  batching:
    mode: prefix-aware
    max_batch_ms: 10
    max_size: 512
  cache:
    enabled: true
    ttl_secs: 3600
  quant_recommendation:
    strategy: per-route
    safety_threshold: 0.03
```

Oliver: Infra needs: rollback hook, auto-fallback to full-precision model on errors, trace sampling for cache misses.

Jason: Legal must approve telemetry; contracts might need minor amendment (est +1 week). Also schedule an internal review Thurs 11:00am.

Miguel: I'll confirm AcmeHealth traffic profile and pilot availability by EOD Friday.

Priya: Timeline: spec PR by Tue, alpha invite list by Fri, pilot rollout in 2 sprints. Owners: @Emma perf/table, @Oliver infra runbook, @Jason pilot flow/legal, @Miguel customer confirmation.

deploy-bot: created doc: https://redwood/drive/optimize-prio-matrix-draft (perm: team)

Emma: :thumbsup:

Oliver: Will add canary playbook and rollback steps to the PR.

Priya: I'll post the matrix doc after the PR and tag owners. :rocket:
